dct_description_sm:
Polygons that provide approximate indications on the location and outline of former quarries and surface deposits in Montreal.

It complements the information provided on the [City Portal] (https://montreal.ca/sujets/anciennes-carrieres).**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
